performed: Mapped benefit/cost imbalance to effort–reward imbalance
Mapped outcome/process/treatment/explanation fairness to organizational justice
Mapped correction burden and exhaustion to Job Demands–Resources
Mapped repeated proof/navigation labor to administrative burden

last_checkpoint_result.result: Most proposed variables are not novel. A single scalar is blocked because perceived unfairness can occur without establishing debt or causation, while adequate reward can coexist with provenance erasure or impaired exit.
last_checkpoint_result.strongest_counterexample: High effort/low reward and poor justice scores do not by themselves prove a specific unpaid debt, causal responsibility, or ownership claim; conversely, high reward does not rule out provenance or practical-exit failure.
last_checkpoint_result.power_reversal: The receiving side retains evidence-preservation and contradiction-logging duties where it controls the records; the contributor is not required to repeatedly reconstruct already-held evidence.
